'''Bujar Dida''' (born May 7, 1961) is an [[Albania]]n [[chemistry]] [[Ph.D]] and [[Doctor of Science|D.Sc]] and the first Ambassador of the Republic of Albania to Japan. He was nominated as ambassador on December 12, 2007, by President [[Bamir Topi]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.qbz.gov.al/botime/fletore_zyrtare/2008/PDF-2008/206-2008.pdf|title=Government Gazette|last=|first=|date=December 2008|website=www.qbz.gov.al|publisher=|access-date=|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150501054405/http://www.qbz.gov.al/botime/fletore_zyrtare/2008/PDF-2008/206-2008.pdf|archive-date=May 1, 2015|url-status=dead}}</ref>

== Early life and education ==
Dida was born in [[Kukës]], [[Albania]].

He holds two academic degrees; "[[Doctor of Science]]" from the [[University of Tirana]] (1994) and "[[Doctor of Philosophy]]" from [[Tohoku University]], [[Sendai]], [[Japan]] (1999).<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.che.tohoku.ac.jp/~tranpo/member/graduate.html|title=Tohoku University, Aoki Laboratory graduate list|last=|first=|date=|website=tohoku.ac.jp|publisher=|access-date=}}</ref> He conducted post graduate studies in Japan with scholarship "[[Monbukagakusho Scholarship|Monbukagakusho]]" (1995–1999) Japan.

== Professional career ==
He has been the director of the project "Education Reform" — [[World Bank]] (2000–2004),<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://documents.worldbank.org/curated/en/876191468004829501/Albania-Education-Reform-Project;jsessionid=v2d3anPubOz4fudRX9LQeBIg|title=World Bank Education Reform|last=|first=|date=April 22, 2005|website=documents.worldbank.org|publisher=|access-date=|archive-date=August 13, 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160813082632/http://documents.worldbank.org/curated/en/876191468004829501/Albania-Education-Reform-Project;jsessionid=v2d3anPubOz4fudRX9LQeBIg|url-status=dead}}</ref> Director General of [[Superphosphate]]s Plant in [[Laç]] (1990–1993), Albania and lecturer for [[Chemical reactor|Chemical Reactors]], [[Physical chemistry|Physical Chemistry]] and [[General chemistry|General]] and [[Inorganic chemistry|Inorganic Chemistry]] at the [[University of Tirana]] and the [[Polytechnic University of Tirana]], where he still continues the main direction of his career.

== Diplomatic career ==
Dida began his diplomatic career as the first [[Consul General|Honorary Consul General]] of Japan in Albania for a 9-year period (2000–2009)

Dida was the first Albanian ambassador to Japan, since the establishment of diplomatic relations between two countries. Dida was nominated in December 2007 and ended his duty in March 2015.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://president.al/?p=25868|title=Release from duty|last=|first=|date=|website=president.al|publisher=|access-date=}}</ref> The post of an ambassador to Japan was vacant and was only instated for the first time after an 87-year period since the time of recognition of Albania from Japan (April 1922) and 28 years after reactivation the relations (March 1981) with Japan.

During his term he was acquainted with several Japanese high officials such as Prime Minister [[Shinzō Abe|Shinzo Abe]],<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.hermesnews.info/articoli/stampa-articolo.asp?IDARTICOLO=29856|title=Hermes News, Life in Japan|last=|first=|date=May 22, 2013|website=|publisher=|access-date=August 10, 2016}}</ref> Speaker of the House of Representatives of Japan [[Bunmei Ibuki]],<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.ambasadat.gov.al/japan/en/meeting-speaker-house-representatives-japan-mrbunmei-ibuki|title=Meeting with the Speaker of the House of Representatives of Japan, Mr.Bunmei Ibuki|last=|first=|date=August 22, 2014|website=|publisher=|access-date=}}</ref> Minister of Foreign Affairs [[Fumio Kishida]]<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.japantimes.co.jp/multimedia/2015/04/11/images/times-gallery/april-11-2015/#.V6s8WPl95D8|title=Japan Times April 11, 2015|last=|first=|date=April 11, 2015|website=|publisher=|access-date=}}</ref> etc..

On 29 April 2018, the Japanese Government awarded the "[[Order of the Rising Sun|Order of the Rising Sun, Gold and Silver Star Rays]]" for his services of contributing to strengthening the bilateral relations between Japan and Albania and promoting Japanese language education, becoming the first Albanian receiving this degree of decoration from the Japanese Emperor.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.mofa.go.jp/files/000358977.pdf|title=2018 Spring Conferment of Decoration on Foreign Nationals|date=29 April 2018}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.kohajone.com/2018/06/22/shqiptari-i-pare-qe-merr-nje-dekorate-perandorake-nga-japonia/|title=Koha Jone, The first Albanian to receive an imperial decoration|date=22 June 2018|access-date=August 7, 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180807125345/http://www.kohajone.com/2018/06/22/shqiptari-i-pare-qe-merr-nje-dekorate-perandorake-nga-japonia/|archive-date=August 7, 2018|url-status=dead}}</ref>

The decoration ceremony was held on June 21, 2018, by Ambassador of Japan in Albania Makoto Ito in the presence of  former President Rexhep Mejdani, Deputy Minister of Europe and Foreign Relations Etjen Xhafaj, Rector of Polytechnic University of Tirana Prof. Andrea Maliqari, many colleagues of former ambassador Dida from MoFA and PUT as well as 80 other invitees.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://ata.gov.al/2018/06/22/japonia-i-akordon-nje-dekorate-perandorake-ish-ambasadorit-bujar-dida/|title=ata.gov.al|date=22 June 2018|access-date=August 7, 2018|archive-date=December 16, 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211216215748/http://ata.gov.al/2018/06/22/japonia-i-akordon-nje-dekorate-perandorake-ish-ambasadorit-bujar-dida/|url-status=dead}}</ref>
<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://alva.al/japonia-i-akordon-nje-dekorate-perandorake-ish-ambasadorit-bujar-dida/|title=alva.al|date=25 June 2018}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.al.emb-japan.go.jp/itpr_en/00_000206.html|title=Embassy of Japan in Albania|date=26 June 2018}}</ref>

== Activities in Japan ==
In the period of service as ambassador to Japan, he and his wife, Reko Dida, held many activities to organize high-level visits, the following are some of the activities and events that Dida attended/organized:
* Promoted further the cooperation with Japan through [[Japan International Cooperation Agency|JICA]] for specific projects and training of human resources.
* Worked closely with [[Japan Foundation]] for cultural exchanges and the development of curriculum teaching Japanese language in Albania.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.jpf.go.jp/e/about/jfic/visitor/2012.html|title=Visit to Japan Foundation|last=|first=|date=June 1, 2012|website=jpf.go.jp|publisher=|access-date=|archive-date=September 20, 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160920091109/https://www.jpf.go.jp/e/about/jfic/visitor/2012.html|url-status=dead}}</ref>
* Collaborated with Japan Association of Travel Agents (JATA) for the development and presentation of Albanian tourism.
* Wrote many articles in [[The Japan Times]] and other media.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://classified.japantimes.com/nationalday/pdfs/20141128-Albania_flag_day.pdf|title=Japan Times Albanian Flag Day|last=|first=|date=November 28, 2014|website=japantimes.com|publisher=|access-date=}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=http://classified.japantimes.com/nationalday/pdfs/20131128-Albania_flag_day.pdf|title=Japan Times Albanian Flag Day|last=|first=|date=November 28, 2013|website=japantimes.com|publisher=|access-date=}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=http://classified.japantimes.com/nationalday/pdfs/20121128-Albania_flag_day.pdf|title=Japan Times Albanian Flag Day|last=|first=|date=November 28, 2012|website=japantimes.com|publisher=|access-date=}}</ref>
* Attended the reception of A-bombed stones from the Stone for [[Hiroshima Peace Culture Foundation|Peace Association of Hiroshima]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.city.hiroshima.lg.jp/www/contents/1325635589182/index.html|title=Hiroshima City, November 2011 news|last=|first=|date=November 2011|website=|publisher=|access-date=|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160823004820/http://www.city.hiroshima.lg.jp/www/contents/1325635589182/index.html|archive-date=August 23, 2016|url-status=dead}}</ref>
* Was invited to several universities and academia to present Albania and its development and promote further the granting of scholarships for students and Albanian inter-university cooperation.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.ambasadat.gov.al/japan/sq/universiteti-osaka-nj%C3%AB-mund%C3%ABsi-tjet%C3%ABr-bashk%C3%ABpunimi|title=Oosaka University Cooperation|last=|first=|date=|website=|publisher=|access-date=}}</ref>
* Attended the Third Black-Sea Conference.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.gfj.jp/eng/dialogue/34/cp.pdf|title=Black Sea Conference|last=|first=|date=January 27, 2010|website=www.gfj.jp|publisher=|access-date=|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160918015231/http://www.gfj.jp/eng/dialogue/34/cp.pdf|archive-date=September 18, 2016|url-status=dead}}</ref>
* Attended the [[Fukushima Prefecture|Fukushima]] [[Ministerial Conference]] on Nuclear Safety, following the events of the [[2011 Tōhoku earthquake and tsunami]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.mofa.go.jp/policy/energy/fukushima_2012/pdfs/participants.pdf|title=Fukushima Ministerial Conference on Nuclear Safety|last=|first=|date=December 17, 2012|website=|publisher=|access-date=}}</ref>
